notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 15.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers.
Holding priority, activate Loxodon Lifechanter by paying {5}{W}, causing it to get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is your life total.
Resolve the Mayael's Aria trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Loxodon Lifechanter, then causing you to gain 10 life and win the game.
